newsitem.title: UK: UK rate rise needed before election - George.
newsitem.headline: UK rate rise needed before election - George.

text.p: Governor of the Bank of England Eddie George said on Thursday he saw no need for a dramatic UK interest rate rise but expected to see a rate rise before the general election.
"We don't see an urgent need for a dramatic step," he told
the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee.
But when asked if did not foresee a rate rise before the general election he said, "I certainly wouldn't go that far".
A general election must be held by May 1997.
